purpose: Qualify the experimental `stormlog infer profile --trace cupti` path and the helper 0.4.0 changes (bounded consumer, CUDA runtime check, subscriber hold) on hardware, and run the pre-declared CUDA-graph window-scaling run that the v2 decision record lists as fix 4. Declared before any of these runs.
scope_note: The v2 decision rule was evaluated on eager mode and stays as decided (defer). This run decides whether the shipped experimental mode behaves as documented, and records whether the graph-mode criteria below are met for a future adoption decision. It does not by itself change the v2 decision.
environment: Same as v2: one JarvisLabs L4, vLLM 0.30.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct at the v2 revision, helper built against the venv's CUDA 13 CUPTI; mismatch control built against the image toolkit.

A_cli_end_to_end.how: qualify_cli.py: vLLM with CUDA graphs and the helper deferred; `stormlog infer profile --trace cupti --trace-max-seconds 20`, concurrency 8, 400 measured requests; the artifact is read back.
A_cli_end_to_end.prediction: One window acknowledged and stopped by time_bound; one activity.sclz per worker imported; activity_ref records present; event_loss all zero.
A_cli_end_to_end.pass: window started and stop confirmed; at least one stormlog-cupti trace imported with activity_ref records; event_loss reported (not null).

B_bounded_consumer.how: run_plan trials q-eager-cupti-min-w800 (default 32 MiB cap) and q-eager-cupti-min-w200-delay50 (writer slowed by 50 ms per buffer).
B_bounded_consumer.prediction: W=800 eager peak added RSS below v2's 234 MiB median, with activity_buffer_peak_outstanding_bytes <= 32 MiB; the delayed trial reports buffer_refusals > 0 with peak outstanding <= 32 MiB.
B_bounded_consumer.pass: peak outstanding buffer bytes <= maximum_buffer_bytes in both; delayed trial buffer_refusals > 0 and finalized; any loss appears in the status counters.

C_runtime_mismatch.how: qualify_cli.py: vLLM (eager) with the helper built against the image's CUDA toolkit (v2: 12.6) under torch's CUDA 13 runtime; then `--trace cupti`.
C_runtime_mismatch.prediction: cupti_status.json names the CUDA version mismatch, no control socket, and the CLI window is rejected with that message.
C_runtime_mismatch.pass: initialization_error names the mismatch; window start_outcome is rejected; no trace imported.

D_coexistence.how: qualify_cli.py: (1) vLLM with the helper and vLLM's torch profiler; `--trace vllm-torch` window; (2) micro_fidelity nsys_trial w1-eager with the helper under Nsight Systems.
D_coexistence.prediction: (1) the helper initializes (torch does not hold the subscriber at startup); Kineto's trace has no or degraded CUPTI GPU activity. (2) the helper reports 'another CUPTI client' instead of a clean empty finalize.
D_coexistence.pass: (2) helper status is not a clean finalize with zero records. (1) is recorded as observed; either outcome is documented, neither passes silently.

E_graph_window_scaling.how: run_plan trials q-graph-*: cupti-min and off, CUDA graphs, W=200, 800, 2200, 3 repetitions each, seeded shuffled order (seed 118), v2 workload.
E_graph_window_scaling.prediction: cupti-min window p95 delta within +2% of the off median at every W; peak added RSS under 150 MiB at every W; stop under 2 s.

graph_mode_adoption_criteria.memory: median peak added RSS at W=2200 no more than 1.5x the W=200 median
graph_mode_adoption_criteria.loss: every trial finalized; loss counters reported
graph_mode_adoption_criteria.statistic: median over 3 repetitions vs off median at the same W; ranges reported, no confidence intervals
